context_policy.rule: Every scheduler must begin from the complete repository state for its checked-out revision, load config/operator_directives.json as the latest explicit operator authority, then read the V7 live champion, scheduler registry and architecture manifest. V3-V6 runtime/config/workflow surfaces are retired and must not be reintroduced. Research that reintroduces live expert averaging, semantic-price averaging, heterogeneous global PCA or an obsolete bounded-policy rollback is non-promotable.

grafana.rule: The canonical operator URL serves the V7 dashboard and exact deployed V7 telemetry.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
